name: debranges-kernels-lehmer-cascade
title: Shifted Hermite-Biehler Kernel Identities, Local Multiplicity Jets, and Truncated Prime-Power Multipliers for Riemann's Xi-Function
description: Exact diagonal identity K_alpha(t-id, t-id) = (alpha/pi)*W_tilde(d,t) for the shifted family E_alpha = Xi - i*alpha*Xi' with explicit Hermite-Biehler equivalence to the Riemann Hypothesis, order-m Jensen-Laguerre multiplicity jets c_{2m-1}(t_0) = [m/(m!)^2]*(Xi^{(m)}(t_0))^2 > 0 and local quadratic bowls, and Leibniz-Wronskian multiplier identities with bounded residual Dirichlet coefficients 0 <= b_n^E(X) <= 1 and explicit strip obstructions.
